page_title: CRE 1-4 FIO | Cremonese v Fiorentina 16/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Luca Ranieri and he is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina).
84' A rebound bounces out to Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
83' Cremonese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
81' Robin Gosens comes off the pitch to be replaced by Daniele Rugani (Fiorentina).
81' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Fabiano Parisi is replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina).
80' That will be all from Federico Ceccherini who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese).
80' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
80' Sebastiano Luperto (Cremonese) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
77' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) blazes a shot from a long-range free kick and the ball ends somewhere in row Z.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Albert Gudmundsson leaves the pitch and Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) comes on.
75' Here is a change. Rolando Mandragora is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Cher Ndour (Fiorentina).
70' 1 - 4 Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) collects a sweet pass and lashes the ball into the top right corner. It couldn't have gone in a better place.
69' We are about to witness a substitution. Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is replacing Romano Floriani.
69' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
68' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
67' David Okereke (Cremonese) gets his head on the corner, but he sees his header blocked.
67' Cremonese earn a corner.
66' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Milan Djuric (Cremonese), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles past the right post. Poor effort.
65' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) is caught offside!
63' Cremonese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
62' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) replaces Youssef Maleh.
61' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

61' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Emil Audero sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net.
61' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' 1 - 3 David Okereke (Cremonese) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
57' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Emil Audero easily catches the ball.
55' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the left post. Poor header!
49' 0 - 3 Dodo (Fiorentina) displays great tekkers inside the box leading to a fantastic goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
49' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
46' The game is over for Morten Thorsby (Cremonese). David Okereke comes on for the second half.
46' Davide Nicola makes a switch. Alberto Grassi is coming on in place of Warren Bondo (Cremonese) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
42' The foul by Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) was seen by Marco Di Bello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
42' The ball is out of play and Fiorentina manage to earn a corner.
41' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) sends it out of play.
41' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
40' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee blows his whistle, Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
38' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
38' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
34' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' 0 - 2 Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) latches on to a killer pass deep inside the box and coolly puts the ball inside the right post!
27' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Marco Di Bello ignores the protests.
25' 0 - 1 Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) scores a goal after a beautiful solo effort. His shot goes into the middle of the goal and behind the helpless goalkeeper.
21' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
18' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David de Gea, who smothers the ball.
15' A player from Cremonese commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
13' The Cremonese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
9' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
7' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
5' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
4' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
3' Cremonese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cremonese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
